Third-party software in the AmiBSDNet package
=============================================

AmiBSDNet includes the following programs and files by other authors,
unchanged, for Wi-Fi encryption (WPA/WPA2). (The PiStorm's Wi-Fi driver,
wifipi.device, is not included: it belongs to your Emu68 installation,
so the one installed with Emu68 is used.) They are not
covered by AmiBSDNet's own licence (LICENSE.txt); their own terms below
apply.


C:WirelessManager
-----------------
WirelessManager 1.5 (24.2.2025) by Neil Cafferkey: the WPA/WPA2 part of
Wi-Fi (a port of wpa_supplicant). Taken from the prism2v2 2.9 archive on
Aminet (driver/net/prism2v2.lha). Its source is in the AROS repository,
workbench/network/WirelessManager (https://github.com/aros-development-team/AROS).

WirelessManager is based on wpa_supplicant. It is dual-licensed under the
GNU General Public License version 2 and the BSD license; it is
